chapter: Closing: recent career, family and travel
title: Living abroad versus New York as the center
summary: Racial atmosphere made him want to stay abroad, yet New York is the center of Jazz.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well, when you cover the territory that I have

outside of the continent of the United States, sometimes you don't want to come home. You know!? It's better to stay elsewhere, you know, because the atmosphere, the racial atmosphere wasn't as inviting as other places. Oh, you'd find prejudice all over the world, but not so much as, you know, here and South Africa.
But quite apart from that, quite apart from any angle of prejudice, I mean, you could find parts of the world that you would enjoy living in more than New York in any event!
It might seem to you a little prosaic in Toronto or Mexico City, but you might like that better.

Yeah, I didn't seem to care... Don't misunderstand me now. I wouldn't say that it was the promised land anywhere else. They just had a different way of showing it. And when you find out that everybody in the world is on their way here, then you become to see...you say well...you become worried... I say, "I wonder if I still have what I left back there."
See what I mean? And all the action really is here. Everyone points, you know...
...especially from the Jazz point of view, New York is the only place to live in any more.
There's nothing much happening in any of the other big cities. New Orleans has its little New Orleans type music, but you know, there's nothing...
I've seen (?). If you can be a big frog in a small pond...
That's all right, but that wasn't for me too much. I like to be in the main stream where things are happening, you know.
Well, there's inspiration to be derived from that, too, isn't there, apart from the competitive thing.
